mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1 but SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate suggests a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE stays below 6 but SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate is low and payroll employment is high, it indicates a strong labor market, which may drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE is low and PAYEMS is high but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to positive economic growth and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST remains above 1000 but SPX 20-day returns are not positive in majority of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate may indicate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5 but SPX 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests stronger economic activity, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but SPX 5-day returns are negative in majority of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth may indicate economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows but SPX 60-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation as indicated by CPI may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to potential monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL remains above 240 but SPX 20-day returns are positive in majority of cases.
